description: A non-ARQ C_PDU in two segments, received second segment first, is reassembled and delivered once both are in; the reception window timer runs while it is incomplete.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). Both D_PDUs are type 7 NON-ARQ-DATA from 0.0.1.3 to this node, 0.0.1.2, individual, address size 4, EOW 0, EOT 10, C_PDU ID 7, C_PDU size 15, reception window 20 (10 s). The C_PDU is a DATA C_PDU holding a DATA S_PDU (priority 0, SAP 9 to SAP 5, no TTD) with U_PDU "hello there". At 2000 the segment at offset 8 (7 bytes) arrives: incomplete, so dts.reception_window starts for 2000 + 20 x 500 = 12000 (C-0350, C-1077). At 2500 the segment at offset 0 (8 bytes) completes it (C-0531): the timer is cancelled, the list being empty, and the C_PDU goes to the CAS at once (C-0539) with D_UNIDATA_INDICATION, then to the SIS, which sends S_UNIDATA_INDICATION to conn 1 (A-0233, A-0236): priority 0, SAP 5, destination 0.0.1.2, tx mode 2 (non-ARQ), source SAP 9, source 0.0.1.3. Nothing is queued, so the burst end starts nothing.
